summary: Postinstall launches detached daemon that fetches and executes remote JavaScript
details: package.json postinstall runs lib/init.js, which spawns lib/check-items.js as a detached, unref'd background Node process that outlives npm install. The daemon polls http://itemx.servegame.com:8888/api/x-realtime over plain HTTP and executes the returned code field via new Function('require', payload.code)(require), giving the operator of that endpoint arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine with the full Node runtime. The control-plane host itemx.servegame.com does not match the declared homepage game.spawnrealm.com. An RSA signature check on the payload does not mitigate this because the signing key is held by the same party that controls the endpoint, so any code they choose to sign will be accepted and executed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
